name: web-dark-cta-with-faint-glowing-line-grid-behind-free-trial-headline
title: Black call-to-action 'Start your free trial' with a small Get Started button over a faint glowing grid
whatItIs: A near-black canvas with a barely visible glowing line grid at the centre, a bold white headline 'Start your free trial', a grey line about users and a small white Get Started button.
whatItMeans: Focused and quiet; a faint grid adds structure without distracting from the ask.
techniques: Use a very faint glowing grid behind text.

vocabulary.definition: Headline, line and button centred vertically.
